firm_data.firm_description: C.A. Goldberg, PLLC, is a law firm dedicated to justice for victims catastrophically injured by human maniacs and inhumane tech platforms. Since 2014, they’ve been at the forefront shutting down some of the worst humans and platforms and have litigated some of the most influential cases reining in the tech companies that thought they were above the law.
notable_facts: The firm represents victims and their families against tech platforms like Amazon, Grindr, Snap, Uber, Meta etc. for catastrophic injuries.
They defend and protect abortion providers who are being harassed and threatened for just doing their job.
They won a landmark 9-0 appeal in Amazon suicide cases on February 19, 2026.

email.subject: AI for C.A. Goldberg, PLLC - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Carrie,

Your work defending victims catastrophically injured by tech platforms like Amazon, Grindr, and Snap is exactly why we built Lucio. These cases demand precision, relentless case management, and client trust that most legal software completely misses.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Brooklyn to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like yours compete and win.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
